name: DNS Spoofing / Poisoning Attack
description: 教学与测试目的：通过 DNS 欺骗（Spoofing）攻击篡改目标主机的域名解析结果，将合法域名重定向到攻击者控制的恶意服务器，实现中间人欺骗。对应 MITRE ATT&CK 影响（Impact）战术阶段的网络服务降级技术（T0814）以及凭据访问阶段的网络嗅探技术（T1040）。

steps.name: Prepare DNS Spoof Configuration
steps.description: 配置 Responder 工具的 DNS 欺骗参数，指定要劫持的域名和恶意解析 IP 地址。
argsTemplate: SPOOF_IP={{host}} && echo "Configuring DNS spoof for target network..." && echo "Spoof IP: $SPOOF_IP" && echo "Domains to spoof: wpad, isatap" && mkdir -p /tmp/dns_spoof && echo "$SPOOF_IP" > /tmp/dns_spoof/spoof_ip.txt && echo 'DNS spoof configuration prepared'

steps.name: Launch Responder for LLMNR/NBT-NS Poisoning
steps.description: 启动 Responder 工具监听网络中的 LLMNR/NBT-NS 名称解析请求，对目标主机的查询返回恶意 IP 地址，实现 DNS 欺骗。
argsTemplate: echo 'Starting Responder for LLMNR/NBT-NS poisoning...' && timeout 30 python3 -c "import time; print('Responder simulation: listening on LLMNR/NBT-NS...'); time.sleep(5); print('Captured hash from spoofed response (simulated)'); print('NTLMv2SSP Hash stored in logs')" 2>&1 && echo 'Responder DNS spoof attack completed'

steps.name: Verify DNS Redirection
steps.description: 验证 DNS 欺骗效果：尝试解析被劫持的域名，确认返回的 IP 为攻击者指定的恶意 IP。
argsTemplate: SPOOF_IP=$(cat /tmp/dns_spoof/spoof_ip.txt 2>/dev/null || echo '{{host}}') && echo "Verifying DNS spoof result..." && echo "Expected spoof IP: $SPOOF_IP" && echo "Simulated nslookup result: wpad.local -> $SPOOF_IP" && echo 'DNS spoofing verification completed - target domain resolves to attacker IP'
